newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India buys one cargo kero from Mobil in Aug tender.
newsitem.headline: India buys one cargo kero from Mobil in Aug tender.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has awarded one cargo of superior kerosene to Mobil in its August tender, traders said on Monday.
The cargo was awarded at three cents per barrel over Singapore spot quotes on a cost-and-freight basis to the Indian ports of Madras or Haldia on the east coast, traders said.
The tender sought 40,000-45,000 tonnes. It closed on July 10 and was valid until July 11.
In its tender for July deliveries, IOC purchased one 40,000-45,000 tonne cargo from Kuwait Petroleum Corp (KPC) at 10 cents over MidEast spot quotes on a free-on-board basis.
